name: APM Elizabeth neutral physical evidence nodes

metadata.description: Deduplicated physical topology nodes derived from exact endpoints of the current candidate road segments, plus unsnapped study anchors.
metadata.scope: APM Terminals Elizabeth candidate access network
metadata.topology_method: Exact coordinate equality at line endpoints plus source-vertex noding: OSM way 1305702109 was split at its existing vertex node_043, which is also an exact Tripoli Street endpoint. No inferred connector or geometry snap was added.
metadata.anchor_policy: Anchors retain their original coordinates and report the nearest road node and distance. Non-exact connections remain pending explicit source geometry.

properties.name: Path A access anchor: NJ Turnpike/I-95 Exit 13A to North Ave approach
properties.source: user-confirmed study sketch coordinate; used as candidate path anchor
properties.connection_status: unresolved directed ramp chain; no connector fabricated

coordinate_provenance.method: user research anchor preserved without snapping

boundary_assignment.limitation: Boundary data are not survey data and do not represent legal boundaries.

official_centerline_research.limitation: Starting carriageway, directed ramp sequence, and signed movements not established.

properties.exact_next_action: Obtain current NJTA interchange plan and NJDOT ramp diagram/videolog, then confirm directed ramp SRIs.
properties.review_scope: Preserved coordinate, jurisdiction assignment, nearest-feature measurement, and documented source observations were rechecked; directed connection and operational gate function remain unresolved.

properties.connection_status: unresolved directed U.S. 1 and 9 ramp chain; no connector fabricated

coordinate_provenance.method: user research anchor preserved without snapping

official_centerline_research.limitation: Complete directed southbound ramp sequence not established.

properties.exact_next_action: Trace a current NJDOT ramp diagram/videolog from a defined U.S. 1 and 9 southbound carriageway and obtain NJDOT confirmation.
properties.review_scope: Preserved coordinate, jurisdiction assignment, nearest-feature measurement, and documented source observations were rechecked; directed connection and operational gate function remain unresolved.
